name: Afterschool Monsters
source:
Ever wanted to see what happens between a videogame protagonist and his rival before they become powerhouses capable of taking down criminal organizations right before their 11th birthday? 

Before becoming a Dessert Titan Master and wielding a literal monster army that can cause an apocalypse at ANY moment (with perhaps a sprinkle of a few gods of space and time), Bran is an ordinary 6-year-old chilling in a playground. 

So instead of fighting the forces of evil, Bran is stuck with the next worst thing- his annoying next-door neighbor and self-proclaimed 'ri-vel', Reuben. 

[from [url=https://renlovesnovels.itch.io/afterschoolmonsters]itch.io[/url]]
